### What to Expect

- **No Win, No Fee** : Most Perth TPD lawyers operate on this basis, meaning you only pay professional fees if your claim succeeds.[[1]](https://www.millnerknight.com.au/no-win-no-fee/wa/)
- **Superannuation Link** : A TPD claim is usually made through the insurance policy attached to your superannuation fund, even if your injury or illness is not work-related.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/MauriceBlackburnLawyers/posts/if-youre-unable-to-work-for-any-health-reason-there-could-be-a-large-lump-sum-pa/1439605821599642/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdwNk56TTFNV0k0GAo)
- **Evaluations** : Lawyers typically offer a free initial claim assessment to review your policy definitions ("any occupation" vs. "own occupation") and medical evidence.[[1]](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/personal-injury/wa/south-perth-6151)[[2]](https://gajic.com.au/tpd-claim-was-denied/)

If you'd like to narrow down your options, please share:

- Is your condition **work-related or a general illness/injury**?
- Have you already **lodged a claim** or been **denied** by your super fund?
